name: What are the functional differences between ceramic tile and marble for a kitchen backsplash?

mainEntity.name: What are the functional differences between ceramic tile and marble for a kitchen backsplash?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tile and marble backsplashes provide moisture resistance, heat tolerance behind cooktops, and durable surface protection for surrounding drywall. From a practical standpoint, marble requires regular sealing to guard against staining from cooking oils and acidic foods, while glazed ceramic or porcelain tiles are non-porous and require lower routine maintenance. HH Remodeling handles custom tile and marble installations in-house, ensuring proper substrate backing, clean finish cuts, and level grout joints that tie directly into your countertops, cabinetry trim, and wall framing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Glazed ceramic tile is non-porous and easy to maintain, while natural marble offers high-end aesthetics but requires periodic sealing to resist stains and etching from food splatters.
